usage: - Use 火山 for a natural volcano, whether it is active or dormant. It is a plain everyday noun, so it works well in both speaking and writing.
- Common collocations include 火山爆發, 火山口, and 死火山. These are the most useful fixed phrases for learners to recognize.
- You can use 火山 as the subject or object of a sentence, just like other common nouns in Cantonese.
- In school science or geography talk, 火山 is very common; in casual conversation, people usually use it when talking about nature, travel, or natural disasters.
